name: Brainblast a Lucky Block!
desc:
🧠💥 BLAST giant Lucky Blocks and collect the RAREST and most POWERFUL Brainrots!

HOW TO PLAY:
1. 🧠 GET SMARTER — the more Brain Power you build, the FURTHER your Lucky Block flies!
2. 💥 BLAST your Lucky Block across the map — reach further to unlock LEGENDARY Brainrots!
3. 🏠 Fill your BASE with Brainrots and earn money!
4. 🔄 REBIRTH for OP Permanent Boosts!

💲 Remember, your Brainrots earn money even while you're offline!
